provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable positive/negative/boundary cell of every rule ID has a rule-referenced fixture of the matching verdict class, and every non-applicable cell carries an explicit rationale; the generator and the strict validator both refuse a gap. Boundary cells count only boundaryRuleRefs. This gate counts rule references by class; it does not show that each fixture exercises its rule. Some cells are currently decided by self-reported or caller-supplied values, and strengthening them to the semantically meaningful fixtures CONFORMANCE-PLAN §14.8 requires remains open for this candidate.

vectors.name: aw-auth-complete-envelope
vectors.reason: Each required role, including the independently authorized payer rather than a Vet signer, signs the unmodified full envelope for this exact Work and context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-mutation-invalidates
vectors.reason: Mutating a signed envelope member invalidates both binding and signature.

vectors.name: aw-auth-listing-signature-scalar-unreduced
vectors.reason: A Listing signature whose scalar is not reduced below the Ed25519 group order (s + L) is invalid under RFC 8032, so the pinned Listing cannot authenticate the seller authority the authorizations are matched against.

vectors.name: aw-auth-operation-index-binding
vectors.reason: ID, index and kind must identify the same signed operation.

vectors.name: aw-auth-work-replay
vectors.reason: Authorization cannot be replayed to another Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-required-role-missing
vectors.reason: Every operation role needs its own authorization.

vectors.name: aw-outer-submitter-is-not-role
vectors.reason: An unrelated outer sender does not alter signed DACS role authorization.

vectors.name: aw-outer-submitter-cannot-fill-authorization
vectors.reason: Even when the outer submitter equals the missing role signer, it cannot replace that role's operation authorization.

vectors.name: aw-payer-signer-mismatch
vectors.reason: Vet/orchestrator authority does not become payer authority.

vectors.name: aw-payer-role-relabel
vectors.reason: A signature for one role cannot be relabelled as payer.

vectors.name: aw-auth-version-algorithm-bound
vectors.reason: Algorithm and version are signed envelope members.

vectors.name: aw-auth-ecdsa-label-confusion
vectors.reason: A valid Ed25519 signature cannot be relabelled as ECDSA-secp256k1.

vectors.name: aw-auth-sr1-label-confusion
vectors.reason: A valid Ed25519 signature cannot be relabelled as an sr1 aggregate.

vectors.name: aw-auth-boolean-phase-index
vectors.reason: Schema validation rejects Boolean true before it can compare equal to integer phase 1.

vectors.name: aw-auth-boolean-operation-index
vectors.reason: Schema validation rejects Boolean operation indexes before semantic indexing.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-bytes-invalid
vectors.reason: A syntactically shaped but false signature is rejected cryptographically.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-base64url-alias
vectors.reason: A non-canonical Base64URL alias of valid signature bytes is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-auth-signature-wrong-length
vectors.reason: An Ed25519 authorization signature must decode to exactly 64 bytes.

vectors.name: aw-auth-public-key-wrong-length
vectors.reason: An Ed25519 public key must decode to exactly 32 bytes.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-network-substitution
vectors.reason: An authenticated capability for another network cannot authorize this Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-execution-substitution
vectors.reason: An authenticated capability for another execution profile cannot authorize this Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-profile-substitution
vectors.reason: The capability must admit the exact signed Work profile.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-schema-substitution
vectors.reason: Authorization consumes the exact authenticated operation-kind and payload-schema map.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-operation-kind-duplicate
vectors.reason: Set-equivalent operation-kind lists with duplicates are not the exact canonical capability list.

vectors.name: aw-auth-capability-proof-profile-substitution
vectors.reason: Authorization cannot adopt a proof profile merely because an attacker re-signed a capability.

vectors.name: aw-auth-forged-self-consistent-roster
vectors.reason: A self-consistent roster and signature set cannot override authenticated agreement, bundle, and payer authority maps.

vectors.name: aw-auth-role-authority-missing
vectors.reason: Missing independent agreement/bundle/payer authority cannot establish a roster role.

vectors.name: aw-auth-cf3-parameter-identity
vectors.reason: Canonical ClaimReference parameters remain in signed bytes but do not split CF-3 party authority or key resolution.

vectors.name: aw-auth-sequential-anchor-nonce-missing
vectors.reason: The sequential-gate AnchorReceipt and its authenticated proof must both bind the applicable Demos writer nonce.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payment-session-context-mismatch
vectors.reason: AtomicPaymentPhaseInputV1 must carry the exact projection of the independently authenticated SessionContext source rather than an unrelated nested copy.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payment-agreement-boolean-alias
vectors.reason: Byte-exact nested Agreement carriage rejects Python's true-equals-one structural alias.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-registry-steward-mismatch
vectors.reason: A rail definition must verify under the independently pinned registry steward, not a caller-selected or capability-authority substitute.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-phase-handler-mismatch
vectors.reason: A steward-signed RailDefinition must still satisfy the native-DEM RD-5/RD-6 shape and match the pinned pay-dem phase.

vectors.name: aw-auth-self-consistent-session-orchestrator-rekey
vectors.reason: Re-signing the commitment, roster, authorizations, and nested session evidence under a substituted orchestrator cannot replace the independently authenticated Atomic session projection.

vectors.name: aw-auth-session-source-evidence-stale
vectors.reason: Recomputing and re-signing the Atomic projection cannot authorize a changed portable SessionContext source when its independent source evidence remains stale.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-accepted-after-session
vectors.reason: A valid steward signature and fresh anchor receipts cannot move RailDefinition acceptance past the authenticated session start.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-v2-supersedes-missing
vectors.reason: A later RailDefinition version must name the prior version it supersedes before registry selection.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-index-address-noncanonical
vectors.reason: A finalized registry index cannot redirect the selected rail to an address other than dacs4:rail:{CF-4(railId)}:{railVersion}.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payee-bound-agreement
vectors.reason: Atomic authorization accepts the distinct payee-bound agreement, commit phase, signature domain, exact payout coverage, and selected pay-dem destination as one authority chain.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payee-bound-cross-domain-signature
vectors.reason: A PayeeBoundAgreementDocument signed under the legacy dacs-agreement domain cannot authorize Atomic payment.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payee-bound-destination-mismatch
vectors.reason: Atomic PB-1 requires the selected pay-dem rail, phase index, and runtime payee destination to equal the co-signed payout binding.

vectors.name: aw-auth-payee-bound-payout-coverage-missing
vectors.reason: A payee-bound agreement must cover every pinned pay phase exactly once before Atomic payment authorization.

vectors.name: aw-auth-session-vet-ref-optional
vectors.reason: Portable SessionContext vetRecordRef is optional; when omitted, the signed Agreement AttestationRef still resolves the applicable Vet operation artifact.

vectors.name: aw-auth-session-vet-ref-operation-mismatch
vectors.reason: Matching signed Agreement and SessionContext AttestationRefs cannot claim a content hash different from the immutable Purchase Vet operation artifact.

vectors.name: aw-auth-agreement-vet-ref-required
vectors.reason: Each buyer and seller AgreementParty requires a normative Vet AttestationRef even though the portable SessionParty copy is optional.

vectors.name: aw-auth-atomic-payer-shape-closed
vectors.reason: AtomicPaymentPhaseInputV1 closes its nested payer and payee records as well as its top-level record.

vectors.name: aw-auth-unknown-string-not-nfc
vectors.reason: A valid signature cannot make a preserved non-NFC authorization member conform to recursive CF-1.

vectors.name: aw-auth-authorizations-unavailable
vectors.reason: Without the operation authorizations the verifier cannot verify any required role; unavailable authority is indeterminate, not a crash.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-for-another-work
vectors.reason: The payer's valid signature over a Work that differs only in expiresAt does not authorize this Work.

vectors.name: aw-auth-orchestrator-signs-as-payer
vectors.reason: A valid orchestrator signature on the payer's payment authorization does not become payer authority.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-network
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another networkId cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-session
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another jobId cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-phase
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another phaseIndex cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-rail
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another railId cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-operation-index
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another operationIndex cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-role
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another role cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-version
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another authorizationVersion cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-validly-signed-other-job-id-first-character-8
vectors.reason: A valid payer signature binding another jobId cannot be replayed into this context.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-registry-index-receipt-after-session
vectors.reason: DACS-4 RTB-1: with acceptedAt and the other receipt in bounds, a finalized registry-index receipt later than session start cannot authorize the rail.

vectors.name: aw-auth-rail-rail-definition-receipt-after-session
vectors.reason: DACS-4 RTB-1: with acceptedAt and the other receipt in bounds, a finalized rail-definition receipt later than session start cannot authorize the rail.

vectors.name: aw-auth-roster-payer-account-not-bundle-derived
vectors.reason: A roster payer nativeAccount that the payer IdentityBundle does not derive is not payment authority.

vectors.name: aw-auth-roster-seller-account-not-bundle-derived
vectors.reason: A roster seller nativeAccount that the seller IdentityBundle does not derive is not payee authority.

vectors.name: aw-auth-pc1-ordinary-arm-not-coerced
vectors.reason: DACS-4 PC-1: an ordinary PaymentPhaseInput (sessionContext) given to the Atomic handler is not renamed into AtomicPaymentPhaseInputV1.

vectors.name: aw-auth-pc1-both-arm-members
vectors.reason: DACS-4 PC-1: a payment input carrying both sessionContext and atomicSessionContext is neither closed arm, and no member is dropped to select one.
